name: collatz_open_arm

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Z2-protected open arm of the holder-first reading, where the fusion cost is the arithmetic of the constant term in the affine iterate.

⊢.justification: The genesis of the predecessor tree at the single point n=1 before any inverse iteration.

⊣.justification: The closed boundary of the k-th level of the tree, containing all predecessors within the interval [1, 2^k].

≻.justification: The forward morphism n -> 2n, the universal even predecessor available at every node.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism n -> (2n-1)/3, available only when n ≡ 2 (mod 3), representing the descent into the odd branch.

⋈.justification: The sequential composition of inverse steps forming a complete path from the root to a leaf.

⊙.justification: The identity of the path as a valid trajectory where every step is a real inverse image.

∈.justification: The fork on the residue class of the current node modulo 3, splitting into the universal even branch and the conditional odd branch.

∋.justification: The reconstitution of the level count from the union of the doubling image and the odd image.

⊤.justification: The affirmative state where the node satisfies n ≡ 2 (mod 3), enabling the odd predecessor.

⊥.justification: The negative state where the node does not satisfy the condition, blocking the odd predecessor.

⊞.justification: The paradice state holding both the doubling (factor 2) and the conditional odd (factor 1/3) contributions simultaneously as the limit 4/3.

◻.justification: The permanent record of the node count and residue distribution at each level k.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: The state before the tree is generated, containing no nodes.
phase_3.true_description: A node exists and has a valid odd predecessor (residue 2 mod 3).
phase_3.false_description: A node exists but lacks an odd predecessor (residue not 2 mod 3).
phase_3.both_description: The level contains a mixture of nodes with and without odd predecessors, holding the branch factor 4/3 as a stable limit.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the system at the root node n=1.
Fork the current level L based on the residue of each node modulo 3.
Apply the doubling map n -> 2n to all nodes in L (universal branch).
Identify nodes in L where n ≡ 2 (mod 3) (affirmative branch).
Apply the odd inverse map n -> (2n-1)/3 to the identified nodes (conditional branch).
Chain the even and odd predecessors to form the set of candidates for level k+1.
Verify that every candidate is a valid trajectory step (self-reference).
Rejoin the even and odd branches to compute the cardinality of level k+1.
Hold the resulting branch factor 4/3 as the simultaneous limit of the two maps.
Record the node count and residue distribution for level k+1.
Compose the new level with the previous history to extend the tree.
Fork the new level L' based on residue modulo 3 for the next iteration.
Identify nodes in L' where n ≡ 2 (mod 3).
Apply odd inverse to the identified nodes.
Rejoin to compute cardinality of level k+2.
Record the census for level k+2.
Close the system at the boundary of the k-th level, containing the full set of predecessors.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The arithmetic of the shortcut Collatz map inverse, translating residue conditions into predecessor existence.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The residue modulo 3 signal that gates the availability of the odd predecessor.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The set of nodes at each level, stored as a finite set of integers.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The level-by-level expansion of the tree, processing all nodes at depth k before moving to k+1.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Lean module CollatzDepthSplit.lean, specifically the theorems col_two_mul, col_odd_pred, and card_predStep.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One 3-adic digit of resolution per level, consumed to maintain the branch factor 4/3.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A level L with cardinality N and residue distribution p.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A level L' with cardinality N + N*p_2, where p_2 is the fraction of nodes at residue 2 mod 3.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is entropy-conservative because the branch factor 4/3 is a fixed point of the level recursion, and the deviation from uniformity decays geometrically, preserving the structural information of the tree.
